name: How long does a custom kitchen renovation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a custom kitchen renovation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a custom kitchen renovation can vary significantly based on the project's scope, complexity, and material lead times. On average, you can expect a custom kitchen renovation to take anywhere from 6 to 12 weeks from demolition to final touches. This timeline includes planning, material ordering, demolition, rough-ins for plumbing and electrical, installation of cabinets, countertops, flooring, and appliances. We provide a detailed project schedule upfront to keep you informed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom kitchen renovations typically take 6 to 12 weeks, depending on the project's complexity and material availability.
